title: Derived completion commutes with internal derived Hom
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $r\geq0$ and $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in A$, and put $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$. In the ordinary derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $C=C_A(f_1,\ldots,f_r;A)$ be the extended alternating localization complex defined in [lem-per-ideal-torsion-cech-computation], with $A$ in degree zero and, for $1\leq p\leq r$, $\prod_{i_1<\cdots<i_p}A_{f_{i_1}\cdots f_{i_p}}$ in degree $p$. For $X\in D(A)$ define $\Lambda_I(X)=R\operatorname{Hom}_A(C,X)$ using [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object ringed site. For all $K,L\in D(A)$ there is an isomorphism in $D(A)$, natural in $K,L$, $$\Lambda_I(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,L))\cong R\operatorname{Hom}_A(\Lambda_I(K),\Lambda_I(L)).$$
